Chapter 899: Chapter 5: Widespread Fame (Please Subscribe)

Deep and constantly exuding gray misty airflows, an irregular crack silently spans across the sky.

Even after observing and comprehending for five hundred years, Lin Yuan was still somewhat obsessed.

The rule fluctuations that manifested from the depths of the crack were extremely obscure, yet they allowed him to constantly gain insights.

“Five hundred years have passed, I’ve devoted half of my energy to comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, and now I have finally reached the pinnacle of the Sixth Realm.”

Lin Yuan felt emotional, “Without this A-grade cave dwelling, it would have taken me five to ten times longer to reach the pinnacle of the Sixth Realm.”

Before his eleventh traversal, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of time and space was at the mid-stage of the Sixth Realm.

Followed by the late stage of the Sixth Realm, and the pinnacle of the Sixth Realm.

Lin Yuan was confident that within two to five thousand years, reaching the pinnacle of the Sixth Realm was unprecedented.

Those at the twelfth layer in the Main Universe spent billions of years and still found it difficult to advance further in the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, even from the mid to the late stage.

And this was based on the premise that they existed at the edge of the river of time, at the essence of life.

Lin Yuan was fundamentally an eleventh-tier being; without Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he probably couldn’t even step through the doors of the Sixth Realm.

But now, having spent only five hundred years, he completed the journey that could take two to five thousand years in the Main Universe, which uplifted Lin Yuan’s spirits.

This time through the traversal, Lin Yuan had only a little over two thousand years of stay; it would be somewhat wasteful if he could only elevate his understanding of space-time to the pinnacle of the Sixth Realm.

“The Seventh Realm of time and space…” Lin Yuan fell into contemplation, after reaching the pinnacle of the Sixth Realm, the only path before him was the Seventh Realm.

According to the information left by the Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master, understanding the Seventh Realm of space and time required at least the pinnacle of ‘Path-opening’ stage.

Here it says “at least”, many who are at the pinnacle of the ‘Path-opening’ stage still remain at the pinnacle of the Sixth Realm in their comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

“If I can reach the Seventh Realm, in the field of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, I can completely surpass those twelfth-tier ultimates of the Main Universe; even if I am still at the eleventh tier, I can easily protect myself.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Just like in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which itself is not of a high level, those strongest eleventh-tier figures wielding Clan Suppression Weapons can easily break through the Secret Realm if they are within it.

But the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, merged into the deepest part of space-time of the Main Universe, the power of twelfth-tier ultimates can easily destroy the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, but unfortunately, they cannot lock onto its exact location.

Unable to find the coordinates of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, strong as the twelfth-tier ultimates are, they can do nothing unless they possess the power to destroy the entire universe; otherwise, they can only watch helplessly as the Xuanhuang Secret Realm opens and closes repeatedly.

If Lin Yuan could comprehend the Seventh Realm of time and space, it would be the same.

Perhaps in absolute power, he is still far inferior to those twelfth-tier ultimates.

But with the comprehension of the Seventh Realm of space-time, Lin Yuan can easily make it so that those twelfth-tier ultimates cannot find his true form.

“I can feel that, to step from the pinnacle of the Sixth Realm into the Seventh Realm, I need to overcome many bottlenecks and shackles.” Lin Yuan looked thoughtful.

“There is still one thousand five hundred years of residence time, there’s no need to rush.”

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts, “Unfortunately, so far, there is still no direction in the Chaos Rule.”

Over the past five hundred years, Lin Yuan devoted the other half of his spirit and energy to other aspects, such as perfecting the eleventh tier of Martial Tao, understanding many Pillar-level Fusion Rules, exploring the Chaos Rule, and so on.

…

“The Origin of the Immortal Realm…”

Lin Yuan looked again at the irregular crack above the sky.

But this time Lin Yuan observed not just the rule fluctuations emanating from it, but the irregular crack itself.

The irregular crack is connected to the Origin of the Immortal Realm, hence the significant rule fluctuations manifested.

Other Jade Immortals, when contemplating the irregular crack, will only feel the oppressive force of heaven and earth leaking from inside, daring not to harbor other thoughts, nor being able to.

The Origin of the Immortal Realm, even forcefully penetrated by the Ancestor of the Immortal Path to establish a ‘channel’, the contemplating Jade Immortals cannot deeply feel anything.

But Lin Yuan is different.

With his understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule reaching the pinnacle of the Sixth Realm, Lin Yuan’s gaze has vaguely transcended the irregular crack, peering towards the vast primordial lands at the deepest part of the Immortal Realm.

“Just by contemplating the rule fluctuations emanating from the Origin Land, it has greatly benefited my understanding of the rules; if I could directly enter the Origin Land to cultivate and comprehend, then…”

Lin Yuan was suddenly moved; any world’s Origin Land is the absolute core, where one can observe the most fundamental aspects of a world.

The level of the Immortal Realm barely coincides with the Main Universe, if he could observe the most fundamental aspects of the Immortal Realm, it would definitely bring unimaginable benefits to the understanding of many rules.

“But the Origin Land of the Immortal Realm has long been occupied by the Ancestor of the Immortal Path…” Lin Yuan looked far and deep, sensing the presence of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path right in the Origin Land.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path being able to establish a channel to the outside world naturally means he can enter the Origin Land.

Given the rich cultivation environment of the Origin Land, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, if not a fool, would definitely reside there permanently.

Lin Yuan’s current strength could forcibly enter the Origin Land, but would definitely be detected by the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

In that case, Lin Yuan would be exposed under the gaze of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.
